title: Remittance Terms by Tier — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
The remittance terms of the Contingency Placement Agreements are set by tier. They fix how collections held in trust for a creditor client reach that client: the basis and frequency of remittance, how quickly a remittance is sent, the smallest remittance, the clearance holdback, and what happens when reversals in a period exceed its collections.

## Remittance basis and frequency

Net remittance means the client is remitted net of fees; gross remittance means the client is remitted gross and invoiced for fees.

| Tier | Net remittance available | Gross remittance available | Frequency set at onboarding | Weekly available | Semi-monthly available |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | yes | no | monthly | no | no |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | yes | no | semi-monthly | no | yes |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | yes | yes | semi-monthly | yes | yes |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | yes | yes | weekly | yes | yes |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | yes | yes | weekly | yes | yes |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | yes | yes | weekly | yes | yes |

## Timing, minimum and holdback

- **Sending period** — the business days after a remittance period ends within which the remittance is sent.
- **Minimum remittance** — the smallest remittance sent, in USD; a smaller net amount is carried to the next period.
- **Clearance holdback** — the business days before a period end within which collections are held back to the next period until cleared.

| Tier | Sent within (business days after period end) | Minimum remittance (USD) | Clearance holdback (business days before period end) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 10 | 25.00 | 5 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 10 | 25.00 | 5 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 7 | 10.00 | 5 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 5 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 5 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 3 | 0.00 | 2 |

## Reversals exceeding collections in a period

| Tier | Handling of a negative period |
|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | carried forward |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | carried forward |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | carried forward |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | carried forward |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | invoiced |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | invoiced |

"Carried forward" means the shortfall is carried against the next period; "invoiced" means the shortfall is invoiced to the client.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Preferred Contingency Agreement client whose net amount for a period is 8.40 USD receives no remittance for that period, because 8.40 USD is below the 10.00 USD minimum; the amount is carried to the next period. The same net amount on a Select Volume Contingency Agreement, whose minimum is 0.00 USD, is remitted.
